## `lr-chord`

Compare weighted relationships between entities. The SVG places entity arcs around a circle in
input order and joins them with ribbons. Arc length represents the entity's total weight.
Ribbon width represents the relationship's weight. The legend lists entities with positive totals.
Hover or keyboard focus on an entity highlights its ribbons and dims the others. Hover or keyboard
focus on a ribbon highlights that ribbon and dims the others.

| Property | Attribute | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | — | Readonly array of up to 32 `LyraChordEntity` values. Assign a new array when entities change. |
| `matrix` | — | Readonly square matrix of relationship weights. Assign a new outer array when weights change. |
| `label` | `label` | Accessible chart name. A host `aria-label` takes precedence. |
| `description` | `description` | Optional accessible chart description. |
| `loading` | `loading` | Shows the loading state. Defaults to `false`. |
| `withDataTable` | `with-data-table` | Shows the data table visually. Defaults to `false`. |
| `dataTableToggle` | `data-table-toggle` | Adds a button to show or hide the table. Defaults to `false`. |
| `valueFormatter` | — | Optional `(value: number) => string` for displayed and accessible values. Formatting follows the effective locale by default. |

Each row and column follows the order of `entities`. Give each entity a unique, nonempty string
ID and a string label. Use finite nonnegative weights, with equal values at `matrix[i][j]` and
`matrix[j][i]`. Mirrored values may differ by a relative tolerance of 1e-9 to absorb
floating-point rounding, and the value above the diagonal is used for both. A positive off-diagonal pair makes one ribbon. A positive diagonal entry
makes a self-ribbon and counts once toward its entity's total. Rows containing only zeros
produce no arcs. Invalid input or more than 32 entities shows an error. Totals that exceed the
numeric range are reported as `Number.MAX_VALUE`. The chart shows a notice if geometry is too
small to represent. A later change into an error is announced assertively. If `valueFormatter`
throws, the value uses the default formatting.

The plot fills the host's inline size and its coordinates follow the rendered size, so entity
labels keep their token font size at any width. Set `--lr-chord-height` to change the plot's
block size; it defaults to `clamp(var(--lr-size-16rem), 100cqi, var(--lr-size-30rem))`. The
circle fits the smaller plot dimension.

Tab enters the first visible entity. Left, Right, Home, and End move within entities or within
the current entity's ribbons. Left and Right follow the reading direction. Down enters an
entity's ribbons and Up returns to that entity.
Hover or keyboard focus reveals the tooltip. Escape dismisses it. The data table lists each
plotted pair once, including self-relationships, with Source, Target, and Value columns. A
second table lists every entity's total, including entities whose total is zero. Both remain
available to assistive technology while visually collapsed.

**Events:** `lr-datum-activate` fires on click, Enter, or Space. It bubbles, is composed, and
carries `LyraChordDatum` detail. Entity detail is
`{ kind: 'entity', id, label, value }`. Ribbon detail is
`{ kind: 'ribbon', source, target, value }`, where `source` and `target` are entity IDs.

Arc labels appear where space permits and are omitted when the circle would become too small;
the full names are available through the tooltip, legend, and accessible names. The diagram
mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
The diagram and legend use the shared `--lr-color-chart-1` through `--lr-color-chart-8` palette.
**CSS custom properties:** `--lr-chord-height`.
**CSS parts:** `base`, `plot`, `description`, `entity`, `entity-label`, `ribbon`, `tooltip`,
`legend`, `legend-item`, `legend-swatch`, `legend-label`, `data-table`, `data-table-toggle`,
`empty`, `loading`, `error`, and `limit`.

```html
<lr-chord id="collaboration" label="Team collaborations" data-table-toggle></lr-chord>
<script type="module">
  import '@aceshooting/lyra-ui/components/lr-chord.js';

  const chart = document.querySelector('#collaboration');
  chart.entities = [
    { id: 'design', label: 'Design' },
    { id: 'engineering', label: 'Engineering' },
    { id: 'research', label: 'Research' },
  ];
  chart.matrix = [
    [2, 10, 5],
    [10, 0, 7],
    [5, 7, 0],
  ];
</script>
```
